newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: TENNIS-CZECHS, INDIA NAME DAVIS CUP TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-CZECHS, INDIA NAME DAVIS CUP TEAMS.

text.p: Petr Korda, Bohdan Ulihrach, Jiri Novak and Martin Damm have been chosen by Czech Davis Cup team captain Vladimir Savrda to face India in the first round of the 1997 world group.
Korda was beaten in the first round of the Australian Open last week by quarter-finalist Marcelo Rios but last year helped power the Czechs to the Davis Cup semifinals where they lost to Sweden.

Olympic bronze medallist Leander Paes will be India's main hope. He has been named for the squad along with Mahesh Bhupathi, Susheel Narla and Nitin Kirtane. The Czechs are seeded fifth, while India, who also lost to Sweden last year, are unseeded. The tie will be played from February 7-9 on indoor clay courts in the town of Pribram, 55km southwest of Prague.
